title: Swap a wall soap dispenser's refill: drop its pump through the keyhole, slide it into the yoke, test-push
instruction: Swap the empty soap refill for the new one, put the empty in the bin, shut the cover and test it with one push.
context: Janitors, housekeeping cleaners and restroom attendants on restroom rounds (O*NET 37-2011.00, 37-2012.00: "Service, clean, or supply restrooms") swap a soap refill whenever a dispenser runs dry. The pump goes through a keyhole hidden under the bottle and must sit over the push bar's fork, so the swap ends with one test push.
setup: Positions in cm: x forward from the midpoint between the arm bases, y left, heights above the table. Push-bar wall soap dispenser, white, 125 x 148 x 271 mm, centred on y 0, on a pale blue plywood board (40 x 36 x 1.8 cm, face at x 40.5) at table height. Back plate x 39.7 to 40.5; side walls x 26.2 to 39.7, 5 to 15 cm up. Ledge, top 15.0 cm up, with a keyhole: 44 x 44 mm entrance centred at x 31.0, 34 mm slot back to x 36.7. Cover, 5 mm, 0.26 kg, hinged at x 26.2, 9 cm up: face 125 x 226 mm, top plate 143 mm deep; starts open 60 deg on its stop; a detent spring (0.35 N m/rad) shuts it within 30 deg of shut. Push lever, 80 g, pivot x 29.0, 12.55 cm up, travel 0.12 rad, spring 0.3 N m/rad: dark bar 110 x 30 x 12 mm (front x 25.2, 5 to 8 cm up), fork with a 24 mm U slot and two 3 mm ridges (top 12.3 cm up). White drip tray 120 x 100 x 15 mm on the table under it (x 27 to 39). Two 600 mL refills, 188 mm tall, pump down: bottle 76 (x) x 64 (y) x 150 mm, 28 mm neck, 22 mm pump, 38 mm collar stroking 10 mm against 250 N/m, 10 mm nozzle. Spent, grey, 0.12 kg: seated, neck axis x 35.3, y 0. New, white, blue band, 0.66 kg: on a blue cradle (two rails 100 x 27 x 50 mm, 46 mm apart) at x 22.0, y -19.0. Fixed waste bin, inside 18 x 18 cm, 15 cm tall, at x 22.0, y 17.0.
scoring: S, N, L at the end; P and D latch over the run. S: spent refill's centre inside the bin's inner 18 x 18 cm footprint, lowest point 1 cm or more below the rim. N: new refill's neck axis within 4 mm of the slot-end seat (x 35.3, y 0), base within 2 mm of the ledge top, tilt 5 deg or less. L: cover within 2 deg of shut. P: after N and L have held 1 s, the lever turns 0.08 rad or more and the pump collar strokes 5 mm or more. D: new refill drops 5 cm or more within 0.5 s while released, or tilts past 45 deg. End: both refills at rest (under 1 cm/s for 1 s) and both grippers 3 cm clear of them, else 0. 1.0: S, N, L, P. 0.75: S, N, L. 0.5: S, N. 0.25: S alone, or N without S. D caps the score at 0.25. Else 0. Real trial: N by ruler (bottle's back face 6 mm from the back plate, within 4 mm; base on the ledge); P when one push hides the pen line 5 mm below the neck.
reset_notes: Slide the new refill forward to the entrance, lift it out and stand it on the cradle. Lift the cover onto its 60 degree stop. Seat the spent refill at the slot end. Empty the bin. Wipe both nozzles; empty and wipe the paper-towel-lined drip tray.
fidelity: Real size, rigid parts. The soap is a solid fill (no slosh or flow); the pump is a collar on a 250 N/m spring, 10 mm travel, softer than a real pump. The cover catch is a detent spring on the hinge (flips 30 deg from shut); no key. The ledge is flat strips. The sim scores without opening the grippers, so a refill held or within 3 cm of a finger scores 0. The real rig is printed (fabricate.py): its refills carry steel shot, not soap, and its cover shuts on a magnet.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (reached its right arm over the cradle, never lifted either refill); demo: 1.0 (swapped the refills, binned the spent one, shut the cover, pulled both arms back)
